strings.string: Create a key in the MyŠkoda app (v8.16 or later), then paste it here. It is masked on this screen but stored unencrypted on the watch.
The 17-character vehicle identification number for the car this key covers. Find it in the MyŠkoda app or your vehicle registration documents.
Unit used for the climate target temperature. Leave unset to use this watch's system unit.
Optional: only needed to start auxiliary heating. Connect IQ stores app settings unencrypted on the watch, so only set this if you accept that trade-off.
Whole degrees, in the unit above. Leave at 0 to use the value your car last reported.
Enter a whole number, or 0 to use the car's last reported value.
A key is created in the MyŠkoda app (v8.16+), not here. It only works for the vehicles you selected when you created it. Enter it in this app's phone settings. Menu for more.
Checking your key against your car…
This hour's request quota is spent. Try again once it resets.
Your key is probably close to expiring: this is an estimate, not a fact. If you would rather not be caught out, create a new one soon in the MyŠkoda app. Select to continue.
